grandline.quest.obj.lesson.strike: Lesson: land a blow on a foe (tap left click; hold it for a heavy blow)
grandline.quest.obj.lesson.guard: Lesson: guard a blow (Combat Mode with %s, then hold right click as it lands; just before the hit = parry)
grandline.quest.obj.lesson.dodge: Lesson: dodge an attack (%s as the blow comes)
grandline.quest.obj.lesson.technique: Lesson: use a technique (Combat Mode with %s, then a number key 1-9)
lesson.grandline.strike: Now land a clean blow: left click.
lesson.grandline.guard: Now guard one: hold right click as the blow comes.
lesson.grandline.dodge: Now dodge one: step out of the way just as it swings.
lesson.grandline.technique: Now use a technique: one of your number keys in combat mode.
lesson.grandline.done: That's the whole lesson. The rest is practice and bruises.
lesson.grandline.fumio.good.strike: Ha! That one rattled their teeth.
lesson.grandline.fumio.good.guard: Good. A guard is just a knot that holds.
lesson.grandline.fumio.good.dodge: Slippery! The King used to dodge like that. Mostly out of chores.
lesson.grandline.fumio.good.technique: Now THAT's a technique. Don't let it go to your head.
lesson.grandline.fumio.guard: Next, guard: hold right click as the blow lands. Tap it right on the hit and you'll parry.
lesson.grandline.fumio.dodge: Next, dodge: when you see the swing, get out from under it.
lesson.grandline.fumio.technique: Next, a technique: combat mode, then a number key. Show me something with a name.
lesson.grandline.fumio.strike: Next, land one clean blow. Left click. Don't flail.
lesson.grandline.fumio.done: That's the lesson. Now go get our flour back.
lesson.grandline.solveig.done: WHAT? You're done? HA! Good! Now go hit somebody who deserves it!
lesson.grandline.percival.done: The wind says you're ready. The wind is usually right. Usually.
lesson.grandline.mahina.done: Lesson's over. You've earned a second helping. Then go chase those thieves.
dialogue.grandline.option.spar: Spar with me (a practice bout that can't hurt you).
dialogue.grandline.spar.unavailable: %s can't spar with you right now.
screen.grandline.scene.next: Click or press Space to continue
screen.grandline.scene.decide: Choose: click an answer, or press its number
screen.grandline.quests.job_label: An optional job: it never blocks the story.
journal.grandline.danger.none: None: nobody to fight on this step
notable.grandline.mio.title: Skipper of the Shiokaze Supply Sloop
dialogue.grandline.notable.mio: If my grandfather sent you, tell him I'm fine. Also tell him the levy is robbery. Also — you wouldn't happen to have a key?
notable.grandline.hayashi.title: Lieutenant, Accounts and Discipline, Shells Town Base
dialogue.grandline.notable.hayashi: Lieutenant Hayashi, accounts. If you have a complaint, there is a form. There is always a form.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.why: Shells Town's Marine captain taxes every crate that crosses his harbour and collars anyone who refuses. Shiokaze's supply sloop came home a third short — and its skipper didn't come home at all.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.cast.fumio: the East Ember. Rigged the Saltfire King's ship for eleven years and still kicks like a mule. Your teacher on Shiokaze Isle.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.cast.mio: Fumio's granddaughter, skipper of the supply sloop. Went to argue with the Marines about the levy and never came home.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.cast.petra: a Marine dock-hand and the best shot on the base, locked in the yard for refusing to fire on a crowd.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.cast.hayashi: the base's lieutenant. Keeps the books, follows the rules, and has started to notice the numbers don't add up.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.cast.gallowga: captain of the Shells Town base. Collects a 'Justice Levy' at baton-point and collars anyone who won't pay.
arc.grandline.decision.shells_plan: how Shells Town faces Iron-Collar (talk to Petra)
arc.grandline.site.shiokaze_shed_thieves: the bandits' camp in Shiokaze's hills
arc.grandline.site.shells_levy_line: the levy line at Shells Town's harbour
arc.grandline.site.shells_levy_thugs: Gallowgate's hired thugs at the harbour
arc.grandline.site.shells_cell_block: the cell block under the base's north wall
quest.grandline.shells_petra.desc: A Marine dock-hand is whistling at you from behind the base's yard fence. Talk to Petra Marlinspike.
quest.grandline.shells_rescue.desc: Mio is locked in the cell block under the base's north wall, and Gallowgate means to march his prisoners to the gallows at dusk. Beat 3 of the bruisers he hired as jailers and free Mio Tsunatori.
quest.grandline.shells_plan.desc: Gallowgate knows the cells are empty and he's coming out. Petra and Mio each have a plan. Talk to Petra and decide how Shells Town faces Iron-Collar.
quest.grandline.shells_square.desc: Petra rings the fire bell and the whole town pours into the square. Fight off 3 of Iron-Collar's loyal guard before he comes down the hill.
quest.grandline.shells_ledger.desc: Take the levy ledger to Lieutenant Hayashi in the base. Once he reads it, the regulars should stand down.
quest.grandline.shells_after.desc: Shells Town is waking up without a levy. Find Mio, who is loading the supply sloop for Shiokaze Isle.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.start.1: fumio|Hmph. So you're the one who's been staring at the horizon all week. Every kid on this rock does it. Most of them never leave.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.start.2: fumio|I rigged the Saltfire King's ship for eleven years. I know that look. Doesn't mean you're ready for what's out there.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.start.4: fumio|Right now? Bandits. They broke into the harbour shed last night and carried half the island's flour, rope and lamp oil up into the hills.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.start.5: fumio|The supply sloop came in light this month already. Now we're lighter. I'd go after them myself, but my knees have opinions.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.start.6: fumio|Take it back. And fight properly while you're at it — I'll be watching. Land a blow, guard one, dodge one, and show me a technique.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.start.7: fumio|If you want to practise first, ask me for a bout. I'm old, not dead.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.talk.1: fumio|Still here? The hills are that way. The bandits aren't going to rob themselves back.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.talk.2: fumio|Want a practice bout first? Say the word. I'll go easy on you. Mostly.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.end.1: fumio|Not bad. You fight like someone who's been hit before and didn't care for it. Good. That's most of it.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.end.2: narrator|Among the recovered crates is the sloop's manifest. Across the bottom, in red ink: JUSTICE LEVY — ONE THIRD. SHELLS TOWN MARINE BASE.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.end.4: fumio|...And the sloop came back without its skipper. Mio. My granddaughter. The crew says she marched up to the Marine base to argue about the levy, and nobody's seen her since.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.end.5: you|You want me to go to Shells Town.
scene.grandline.ember_east_1.end.6: fumio|I can't sail any more. You can. Find her. Bring her home if she'll come, and drag her if she won't.
scene.grandline.ember_east_2.start.1: fumio|Shells Town is east by north. Follow the gulls and the smell of gunpowder. Keep that chart dry — it's older than you, but the islands haven't moved.
scene.grandline.ember_east_2.start.2: fumio|Captain Gallowgate runs the base there. Twenty years ago he was a decent officer. Then somebody gave him a strongbox.
scene.grandline.ember_east_2.start.3: fumio|Don't start a war you can't finish. Find Mio first. Then do whatever the sea tells you.
scene.grandline.ember_east_2.end.1: narrator|Shells Town. A Marine flag on every roof, a base on the hill, and a queue at the harbour: fishermen, bakers, a girl with a goat, each holding out a purse.
scene.grandline.shells_1.start.1: marine|Next! Justice Levy: one third of goods or coin. Justice keeps you safe.
scene.grandline.shells_1.start.2: resident|Safe from who? You're the only ones who ever rob us!
scene.grandline.shells_1.start.3: marine|Insolence. That's an extra tenth. Next!
scene.grandline.shells_1.start.4: narrator|Every third coin goes into an iron box stencilled JUSTICE. Nobody in the queue looks at you. Everybody is watching you.
scene.grandline.shells_1.marine.start.1: narrator|You arrive in Marine blue. The queue at the harbour goes quiet; a fisherman steps in front of his daughter.
scene.grandline.shells_1.marine.start.2: resident|Another one. What's the levy today, Officer? Half? The boat?
scene.grandline.shells_1.marine.start.3: you|There's no such thing as a Justice Levy in the regulations.
scene.grandline.shells_1.marine.start.4: resident|There is in Shells Town. Ask the men Gallowgate hired to collect it — they're not even Marines.
scene.grandline.shells_1.end.1: narrator|The last collector drops his ledger in the mud. The columns are tidy: LEVY RECEIVED, every week for three years. LEVY SENT TO HEADQUARTERS: nothing. Not once.
scene.grandline.shells_1.end.2: narrator|Beneath that, a list headed COLLARED. Halfway down: M. TSUNATORI, SKIPPER. REFUSED LEVY. THREW A FISH.
scene.grandline.shells_1.end.3: petra|Psst! You — with the ledger! Over here, by the yard fence. Quick, before the watch turns round.
scene.grandline.shells_petra.end.1: petra|Keep your voice down. I'm Petra. Marine — technically. Dock-hand, best shot on the base, currently confined to the yard.
scene.grandline.shells_petra.end.2: petra|Last week the town marched up the hill about the levy. Gallowgate ordered us to fire on them. I put my musket down. So here I am.
scene.grandline.shells_petra.end.3: you|I'm looking for Mio Tsunatori. The ledger says she's been collared.
scene.grandline.shells_petra.end.4: petra|Mio? Loud, stubborn, threw a mackerel at the captain? She led that march. She's in the cell block under the north wall with six others.
scene.grandline.shells_petra.end.5: petra|And at dusk Gallowgate marches every one of them down to the harbour gallows in iron collars. 'An example.' His word.
scene.grandline.shells_petra.end.6: petra|He doesn't trust his own men with the cells — he hired bruisers from the hills. Three of them, and the big one has the key ring. I can't touch them. You can.
scene.grandline.shells_rescue.end.1: mio|About time! Somebody tell my grandfather I wasn't 'being dramatic', I was being RIGHT.
scene.grandline.shells_rescue.end.2: mio|Gallowgate's been skimming the levy for three years. Every coin goes into a strongbox in his office, and that ledger proves it.
scene.grandline.shells_rescue.end.3: petra|The bell's already ringing on the hill. He knows the cells are empty. He'll come out now — he can't let the town see you walk free.
scene.grandline.shells_rescue.end.4: mio|Then we don't hide. We just have to pick how.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.talk.1: petra|Two ways to do this. I've been thinking about both since the bell started.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.talk.2: petra|Mine: we call him out in the square, in front of everyone. He'll bring his loyal guard and it'll be a brawl — but the whole town watches Iron-Collar fall, and nobody's afraid of him again.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.talk.3: mio|Mine: we take the ledger to Lieutenant Hayashi. He keeps the base's books and he's honest — boring, but honest. Once he reads it, the regulars stand down and Gallowgate fights alone.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.talk.4: petra|Hayashi will impound the strongbox as evidence. The town won't see a coin of that money for a year.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.talk.5: mio|And Petra's way, the Marines remember who humiliated one of their captains in public. Your call.
scene.grandline.choice.shells_plan.squar: Call him out in the square. The whole town should see Iron-Collar fall.
scene.grandline.choice.shells_plan.ledge: Take the ledger to Lieutenant Hayashi. Let the Marines arrest their own captain.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.end.square.1: petra|The square it is. I'll ring the fire bell — everyone comes running for the fire bell.
scene.grandline.shells_plan.end.ledger.1: mio|Hayashi's office is in the base, by the gate. Knock twice. He hates it when people knock once.
scene.grandline.shells_square.start.1: narrator|The fire bell rings. The square fills: fishmongers, bakers, children on shoulders, old men with walking sticks.
scene.grandline.shells_square.start.2: narrator|Gallowgate's loyal guard marches out first, batons drawn, to clear the square before their captain arrives.
scene.grandline.shells_square.start.3: petra|Three of them. Keep them off me and I'll keep them off you.
scene.grandline.shells_square.end.1: narrator|The last of the guard goes down. The crowd doesn't cheer — not yet. Everyone is looking up the hill.
scene.grandline.shells_ledger.end.1: hayashi|Lieutenant Hayashi, accounts. You have a complaint? There is a form — ...this is the levy ledger.
scene.grandline.shells_ledger.end.2: hayashi|Three years. Nothing sent to headquarters. Not once. And I've been signing off on these totals.
scene.grandline.shells_ledger.end.3: narrator|He reads it twice. Then he closes it gently, like a coffin lid, and walks out into the yard.
scene.grandline.shells_ledger.end.4: hayashi|Regulars! Muskets down. The captain is under investigation. ...I'm told he will resist, civilian. We won't stand in your way.
scene.grandline.shells_2.start.1: gallowgate|You. You're the one who's been stirring up my town. Nobody collars Iron-Collar.
scene.grandline.shells_2.start.square.1: narrator|Captain Mordecai Gallowgate strides down the hill in his iron collar of office, a hammer the size of a door on his shoulder.
scene.grandline.shells_2.start.square.2: gallowgate|A rookie and a disgraced dock-hand. I'll collar you both and hang you in the same breeze.
scene.grandline.shells_2.start.ledger.1: gallowgate|Pick those up! Pick up those muskets! I am your CAPTAIN!
scene.grandline.shells_2.start.ledger.2: hayashi|You're under investigation, sir. The men have been told not to interfere.
scene.grandline.shells_2.start.ledger.3: gallowgate|Then I'll do it myself. Starting with you, rookie.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.1: narrator|Iron-Collar goes down like a dropped anchor. Down at the harbour, the levy line breaks up on its own.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.square.1: narrator|Iron-Collar goes down like a dropped anchor. His hammer rings once on the cobbles and lies still.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.square.3: narrator|Somebody breaks open the strongbox in the middle of the square. Coins roll everywhere — and for once nobody fights over them. They go back to the shops they came from.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.square.4: petra|...Huh. I thought it'd feel bigger. It just feels like morning.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.ledger.1: narrator|Iron-Collar goes down like a dropped anchor. His hammer rings once on the yard stones and lies still.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.ledger.2: hayashi|Captain Gallowgate is relieved of command. The strongbox and the ledger are evidence. The levy is suspended pending review. Permanently, if I write the review.
scene.grandline.shells_2.end.ledger.3: hayashi|...Thank you, civilian. Quietly. The regulars will remember who did this the right way.
scene.grandline.shells_after.start.1: petra|Mio's down at the harbour, already shouting at the supply sloop. Go on. She'll want to see you.
scene.grandline.shells_after.end.1: mio|Full holds and no levy. I sail for Shiokaze on the tide. Grandfather owes you a drink he'll pretend he never promised.
mio|Look at it! Full holds! Flour, rope, lamp oil, and three crates of somebody's 'confiscated' pickles. Grandfather loves pickles.
mio|The shops opened again this morning. Old Tatsu at the chandlery says you never pay full price in his shop again, and he means it.
resident|That's the one! From the square! Let them through, let them through!
mio|I sail for Shiokaze on the tide. Grandfather owes you a drink he'll pretend he never promised.
mio|Look at it! Full holds — and nobody standing on the pier with a box marked JUSTICE.
mio|Hayashi has the strongbox locked up as evidence, so nobody gets their money back yet. But the levy's gone, and the Marines up there are... polite. It's unsettling.
marine|Morning, miss. Morning, er — friend. The lieutenant says you're a friend of the base.
mio|I sail for Shiokaze on the tide. Grandfather owes you a drink he'll pretend he never promised.
scene.grandline.recruit_petra.start.1: narrator|Petra is sitting at the end of the pier with her musket across her knees, watching the horizon the way you used to.
scene.grandline.recruit_petra.end.1: petra|They offered me my old post back. I said no. I'd rather see what's past the horizon.
scene.grandline.recruit_petra.end.2: petra|I'm a sniper. I don't take a shot unless it saves someone. If that works for you, ask me. Properly.
scene.grandline.recruit_petra.end.3: mio|Before you go — Orange Town's harvest festival is under siege by a distiller-pirate called Rotgut. If you're collecting lost causes, that one's ripe.
scene.grandline.recruit_petra.end.square: petra|Hayashi offered me my old post back. Clean record. Even a promotion, if I keep my head down.
petra|But I watched you walk into that square with the whole town behind you. I want to be on that side of the square.
petra|I'm a sniper. I don't take a shot unless it saves someone — that's my rule, and it isn't changing. If that works for you, ask me. Properly.

mio|Before you two run off — the sloop's crew picked up news at sea. Orange Town's harvest festival is under siege. A distiller-pirate called Rotgut is turning the whole crop into liquor, and the town band has scattered.
petra|Orange Town's south-west of here. If we're collecting lost causes, that one's ripe.
scene.grandline.recruit_petra.end.ledger: petra|Hayashi offered me my old post back. Clean record. His idea.
petra|You trusted the coat to do the right thing, and this time it did. I'd like to see how many other times it doesn't — from the outside.
petra|I'm a sniper. I don't take a shot unless it saves someone — that's my rule, and it isn't changing. If that works for you, ask me. Properly.

mio|Before you two run off — the sloop's crew picked up news at sea. Orange Town's harvest festival is under siege. A distiller-pirate called Rotgut is turning the whole crop into liquor, and the town band has scattered.
petra|Orange Town's south-west of here. If we're collecting lost causes, that one's ripe.
recap.grandline.ember_east_1: Took Shiokaze's stolen supplies back from the bandits in the hills, while Old Fumio taught you to fight.
recap.grandline.ember_east_2: Learned that the supply sloop's skipper, Fumio's granddaughter Mio, never came home from Shells Town — and sailed there to find her.
recap.grandline.shells_1: Broke up the levy line at the harbour and found the ledger: the 'Justice Levy' goes into Captain Gallowgate's own strongbox, and Mio is on his list of the collared.
recap.grandline.shells_petra: Met Petra Marlinspike in the base yard, locked up for refusing to fire on a crowd. Gallowgate means to march his prisoners to the gallows.
recap.grandline.shells_rescue: Beat the hired jailers and got Mio out of the cell block.
recap.grandline.shells_plan.square: Decided to call Iron-Collar out in the square, in front of the whole town.
recap.grandline.shells_plan.ledger: Decided to put the levy ledger in Lieutenant Hayashi's hands.
recap.grandline.shells_square: Fought through Iron-Collar's loyal guard as the fire bell rang.
recap.grandline.shells_ledger: Lieutenant Hayashi read the ledger, and the regulars set down their muskets.
recap.grandline.shells_2.square: Brought Iron-Collar down in front of the whole town. The strongbox went back to the shops it was squeezed from.
recap.grandline.shells_2.ledger: Brought Iron-Collar down. Lieutenant Hayashi relieved him of command and impounded the strongbox as evidence.
recap.grandline.shells_after: Watched the supply sloop load up full for Shiokaze Isle, with Mio at the helm.
recap.grandline.recruit_petra: Petra turned down her old post. She'll sail with you if you ask — and the sloop's crew brought news of trouble in Orange Town.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.bonus.square: The whole town saw Iron-Collar fall. Shells Town's shopkeepers won't forget it (15% off in Shells Town) — and neither will the Marines.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.bonus.ledger: Lieutenant Hayashi impounds the strongbox as evidence, then quietly hands you two pairs of seastone cuffs 'for the next one'. The Marines will remember you kindly.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.aid.square: The square is chanting your name. Every blow lands harder for it.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.aid.ledger: Hayashi's regulars close a ring around the fight. Nobody else gets a swing in, and you take less punishment.
arc.grandline.recruit_hint.petra: Petra will join your crew if you ask: talk to her and choose to invite her aboard.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.fumio: Mio's home, the sloop's full, and Iron-Collar's somebody else's problem. Hmph. Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.fumio.s: Half the East Blue's heard you flattened a Marine captain in front of a whole town. Expect trouble. Good — trouble's how you learn.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.fumio.l: You let the Marines arrest their own captain. Clever. The King would've thrown him in the harbour — but clever.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.mio: The sloop sails every week now. Full holds, no levy. Grandfather says hello — he says it grumpily, but he says it.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.during.mio: Psst! These collars chafe. If you've got a key, I've got a sloop to sail.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.petra: Still here? The horizon's that way. ...I'm still waiting to be asked, by the way.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.during.hayash: Lieutenant Hayashi, accounts. If you have a complaint, there is a form. There is always a form.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.hayashi: The levy is suspended. Permanently, if I write the review. I am writing the review.
You humiliated a Marine captain in a public square. He deserved it. I still have to write it down. In triplicate.
Civilian. The court-martial is scheduled and the paperwork is... immaculate. Thank you. Don't tell anyone I said so.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.townsfo: No levy line at the harbour this morning. First time in three years. Feels like a holiday.
You're the one from the square! Come in, come in — no, put your purse away. We remember who gave us our money back.
They say the Marines arrested their own captain. Strange days. Good ones, maybe.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.marines: Lieutenant Hayashi's in charge now. Things are... quieter.
...We know who you are. The lieutenant says leave you be. We're leaving you be.
At ease, friend of the base. Lieutenant's orders: you get the good coffee.
arc.grandline.justice_levy.after.townsfo: The supply sloop came in full! First time in three years. Old Fumio's been almost cheerful. Almost.
